# Prey Caveats
## Synths - Synths interfering with an ongoing hunt without attacking the Yautja, such as bodyblocking or trying to move the prey away, are [color=#57b339]worthy[/color]. - Synths attacking or hindering a Yautja in defense of others, such as disarming you, stealing your weapon or hitting you to protect the prey you're hunting, are [color=#ff0000]dishonorable[/color]. - Synths attacking or hindering a Yautja in self-defense, because you hit them first, are [color=#57b339]worthy[/color].
## Carriers, facehuggers and other threat infectors If a carrier or another non-xenomorph threat infector caste is spectating or loitering during a fight between you and a xenomorph or threat member, assume they're there to infect you. Following you while out of combat, or chatting you up for a long time, can be for the same reason. This makes them [color=#57b339]worthy[/color].
If a facehugger or popper does any of the above, you may use dishonorable tools at will.
## Abominations and aberrations Abominations and aberrations are considered the worst thing in existence and should be eliminated with every Yautja-made tool in your arsenal. Focus on killing the abomination while minimizing unnecessary kills, though some are to be expected.
- Yautja may form a ceasefire with GOVFOR or OPFOR to concentrate on killing the abomination or aberration, but you must then focus on the abomination or aberration only. - If you get infected, you must die at any cost. - If you encounter a living infected Yautja, you are to make sure they die and, if possible, self-destruct their body. - Self-destructing to kill an infected Yautja, an abomination or an aberration is a last resort, not the first solution. - Should an abomination or aberration be on the ship, hunters may go aboard to destroy it, even after hijack. - Once it is dead and the proof of its existence has been removed, all Yautja are to leave the ship as soon as possible.
## Hive offensives In the case above, or when 5 or more xenos join a fight against a Yautja, other Yautja may join in freely unless the engaged Yautja demands otherwise. Should other Yautja join in, the temporarily dishonorable status from being attacked first goes away.
If the Yautja instead began a hunt on one or two xenomorphs and more xenos join, other Yautja may assist only if the number is much higher, for example the entire hive.
## Hive disruption Yautja may hunt xenomorphs before T3s, but should be mindful of what they do and how much. Hold back if you initiate engagements yourself. You are responsible if early hunting leads to major round impact, and may be punished should it violate the spirit of the whitelist.
## Prey status inheritance Anyone who directly or indirectly aids the prey you're currently engaged with inherits that prey's status, for example drone castes providing weeds and pheromones. Those helping worthy prey become worthy, and those helping dishonorable prey become dishonorable.
